name: ribosomal protein S19

function.text: RPS19 encodes small ribosomal subunit protein eS19. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of ribosome and fibroblast growth factor binding. It participates in translation and cytoplasmic translation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Diamond-Blackfan anemia (autosomal dominant); Diamond-Blackfan anemia 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
